sources.what: Supplementary Data 1: DREAM5 network inference challenge data (inputs, gold standards Net1-4, anonymization maps, MATLAB evaluation scripts, null probability densities)
sources.license: Upstream rights retained; no blanket license grant is made by WorkflowArena.

sources.what: Supplementary Data 2: official scores (Overall/AUPR/AUROC scores, per-network AUPR/AUROC incl. Net2) for 35 methods + community
sources.license: Upstream rights retained; no blanket license grant is made by WorkflowArena.

sources.what: Supplementary Data 3: network predictions of 29 participants, 6 off-the-shelf methods, community integration
sources.license: Upstream rights retained; no blanket license grant is made by WorkflowArena.

sources.citation: Marbach D. et al., Wisdom of crowds for robust gene network inference. Nat Methods 9, 796-804 (2012)

derived.environment/inputs/Network*/chip_feature: Supplementary Data 1 network input tables, renamed without data changes.
derived.environment/inputs/Network*/regulators.t: Supplementary Data 1 network regulator lists, renamed without data changes.
derived.tests/reference/leaderboard_official.csv: Supplementary Data 2, sheet 1 columns B-M; method names from Supplementary Data 3.

distribution: Original model/input files are fetched from the publisher using environment/fetch/sources.json; locally prepared files are excluded from Git. Evaluator reference values are derived numerical assessments with source attribution.
